entries.observation: Two people opening a category page went straight to the chips and ignored the picks band above them.

evidence.reference: Example entry. Not an observation about this site.

entries.hypothesis: The picks read as advertising rather than as a shortcut.
entries.proposedChange: Try naming what each pick is best at in the card itself, rather than above the row.

entries.observation: A partner asked which of two products was cheaper per serving and could not tell from the cards.

evidence.reference: Example entry. Not an observation about this site.

entries.hypothesis: Pack price is what the card shows, and per-serving cost is what the question is about.
entries.proposedChange: Show cost per serving on the card for drinks, beside the pack price rather than instead of it.

entries.observation: Reading the code: a filter that matched nothing was hidden, so a shopper arriving on a facet URL with no matches had no control to undo it.

evidence.reference: Example entry. Not an observation about this site.

entries.proposedChange: Keep a selected option visible even when it matches nothing.
entries.outcome: Changed. The chip is kept when it is the selection the page arrived with.
